capabilities: Ask questions about selected text with answers saved as collapsed callouts below the paragraph
Chain follow-up questions that build on the note's prior Q&A history
Rewrite a paragraph incorporating the gathered answer callouts, then remove them
Translate selected words or phrases inline in parentheses
Configure OpenAI model, reasoning effort, web search, and response language
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README mentions a separate web app deployment with a link to learn more. Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later.
motivation: The author wanted AI to live symbiotically with the note, working inside the exact paragraph being read or written rather than in a separate chat window.
problem: AI chat plugins treat the chatbot as a separate place you go to, so asking about the exact sentence you are stuck on means copying text out of context.
summary: AI assistant that answers questions about the paragraph you are editing, translates selected phrases inline, and rewrites text, saving answers as callouts.
